statement: The cited all-finite centralizer proofs contain an unverified closure-intersection step. A noncircular induction from prime-power normalizer and congruence inputs proves the solvable comparison. For geometric A5 on a punctured sphere, the completed and discrete centralizers have the same puncture-permutation image: exceptional orbits are fixed pointwise and m free orbits have image A5^m semidirect S_m. The pure completion equality at all refinements remains unproved here.

notes: No counterexample to the source theorem is asserted. The two maps from completed discrete centralizer to its closure and from that closure to the ambient completed centralizer are typed separately. The exact remaining finite-refinement intersection criterion is proved by compactness. For the minimal twelve-puncture action, the residual centralizer is placed inside the specified embedded Fhat13 pure A4 centralizer and all24 six-point plus all12 seven-point forgetting kernels. The six-point joint map is proved noninjective by two explicit invisible peripheral meridians. The seven-point maps retain all14 collision points; their executed joint H1 map over F101 has rank6 and kernel dimension7. F.9 subsequently proves the full seven-point map noninjective; the actual centralizer remains undetermined. All finite tests are executed. F8 now proves equality of all twelve seven-point kernels, absence of nonidentity reducible elements in the discrete kernel, and trivial intersection of the completed kernel with every conjugate of every full source cusp. Each cusp is detected by a four-point twist character with multiplier one or two. F.9 gives an explicit nontrivial common kernel word, with embedded full procyclic closure, and proves that every six-point constraint factors through a seven-point one. The A5 centralizer equality remains unproved. The exact common-C3 quotient now embeds the specified Fhat13 into the completed pure mapping class group of the six-punctured quotient, using only the established prime-power centralizer/topology case. All six labels, rational coordinates, the extra involution, the algebraic icosahedral basepoint, and the transport path to F9 are displayed. Formula F.7.17 identifies the residual A5 centralizer exactly as the fixed intersection under that based involution. The matrix certificate passed 180 generator products and 720 vertex labels. F10 excludes the full procyclic closure of every nontrivial discrete pure mapping class, including the F9 kernel direction. The full fixed intersection remains unresolved. The exact modular comparison F7.19-F7.32 identifies the full pure multiplier-one peripheral A5 centralizer with GT0^1 via the characteristic S3 and A5 kernels of C2 coproduct C3. The actual based covering and cusp labels identify it with the given twelve-vertex action. Both normalization inverses are proved. The remaining completed geometric centralizer equals the intersection of this GT0^1 image with the completed pure geometric subgroup. The220 actual three-cusp filling detectors reduce to five kernels by exact A5 equivariance, with orbit sizes20,60,60,60,20. Their joint injectivity and the geometric intersection remain unresolved. Equations F7.33-F7.41 identify the actual orbit-twenty detectors through an explicit index-twenty orbifold subgroup C3 coproduct C3 coproduct F3, four exact filling quotients, and a common embedded section of all four surface quotient maps. The actual detector remains the outer class of p_i eta_f^H iota0|K. A nontrivial common source-group kernel word is exhibited but gives only an inner E automorphism; outer detector faithfulness and the geometric intersection remain unresolved. F7.42-F7.48 give the exact first detector coordinate F0=y^B p0(d^-j f^-1 e^j)^-1 x^A, prove its full correction-lift invariance and kernel equation W=x^A y^B, and retain the exact pre-filling naturality defects. The common section is a proper full self-embedding of K despite inducing automorphisms on every free pro-p quotient; its trivial A5 image explicitly detects the missing surjectivity. Faithfulness of the outer detector family remains unresolved. F7.49-F7.57 prove the full unit boundary generation test for the modular orbifold, identify GT0^1 with the exact solution space S modulo g->d^{5t}g, and give the unique first-detector kernel slice S intersect ker(p0). A unique H cone conjugator supplies all five based filling equations. The 60-coset presentation, 95 exact Tietze eliminations, all five inverse full-basis maps, and exact cusp words were executed and independently rerun. Four C3-stable detectors use the same source word R(g). The simultaneous full equations and their intersection with the actual completed geometric subgroup remain unresolved. F16 constructs a full Zhat inside the correcting centralizer killed by every proper labelled forgetting and disjoint from the original curve image. Thus the pullback membership test using all proper forgetting images is strictly larger even after centralization. The original source-equalizer obligation remains unresolved. F17 proves the literal ordered drilling needs sixteen new source punctures and cannot factor through the original source map. F18 proves the unique canonical centralizing branch lift for every actual residual element, using the full two-class cocycle comparison and literal V4 stabilizer labels. The remaining rational-source membership is the displayed K+ right-coset test; neither its universal vanishing nor triviality of the residual is asserted. F19 gives the actual joint forgetting kernel D+ generated normally in the ambient group by eight source collision meridians, its unique-corrector cocycle comparison, and the precise D+/K+ target of source membership. The drilled image K+ semidirect L and full two-track pullback D+ semidirect L have the same explicitly split quotient. No K+=D+ or residual-triviality conclusion is asserted. F20 proves the actual rank-three divisor coset action, all eleven exact based source generators, full one-point forgetting and finite wreath comparison. The 82 invariant A5 quotients, all 3321 paired quotients, and six noncentral 60*2^121 quotients have transitive source actions; K+ and D+ have equal full images under these specified maps for every coefficient prime. The full K+ membership and residual equalizer remain open. F21 proves closed normal_D+(K+)=D+ and onto maps from K+ to D+ abelianization and its maximal pronilpotent quotient. It retains all eight actual divisor labels and original source whiskers. K+=D+ and the original residual membership remain unresolved.
